channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Avery Johnson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Avery Johnson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Deron Williams on Avery Johnson
item.description:
“I have to figure out how to balance. When I said the comments that our offense was heavy on isolation plays, that's a lot of our guys games. That's a lot of Joe (Johnson's) game. That's how he's coachable.”

Deron Williams on Avery Johnson, Dec 27, 2012. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Avery Johnson
item.description:
“I never thought I’d want to coach, but now I kind of want to transition into that, kind of learning from (Johnson),”

Jerry Stackhouse on Avery Johnson, Oct 2, 2012. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: CJ Watson on Avery Johnson
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:CJ Watson:

“I'm excited to join the Nets. I can't wait to play with all that talent and play for Avery Johnson. I couldn't be more excited.”

CJ Watson on Avery Johnson, Jul 14, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Avery Johnson, Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King
item.description:
Prokhorov said in the statement.

“My congratulations and appreciation go out to general manager Billy King, assistant general manager Bobby Marks and head coach Avery Johnson for their tenacity, nerve and heart throughout this process. With the re-signing of Deron Williams and the trade for Joe Johnson, we go into our new home led by an All-Star backcourt and with every hope of a great season for the Brooklyn Nets. I can’t wait until opening night.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Avery Johnson, Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King, Jul 13, 2012. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kris Humphries on Avery Johnson
item.description:
Kris Humphries:

“I’d like to be back. But you never know sometimes. I’m so glad that Coach Avery Johnson gave me the opportunity. I learned a lot and I had gotten better every year. I’m looking to continue to do that. But it’s the NBA. You never know what’s going to happy. You might be hoping for one thing, but in the end ... it’s the NBA.”

Kris Humphries on Avery Johnson, Jun 4, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Derrick Favors on Avery Johnson
item.description:
The way Derrick Favors remembers it, Avery Johnson called him into the coach’s office during a road trip and gave him false assurance.

“(Johnson) was like, ‘We like you here in Jersey, we’re going to keep you, don’t worry about it,’”

Derrick Favors on Avery Johnson, Jan 15, 2012. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Derrick Favors on Avery Johnson
item.description:
In February – after incessant rumors and after Nets officials meeting with Carmelo Anthony while dangling Favors – the 2010 third overall pick was dealt with Devin Harris and two first-round picks for Deron Williams.

“They tell everybody that (they’re part of the future). I’m not calling (Johnson) a liar or anything, but when you’re on a team, you buy into it,”

Derrick Favors on Avery Johnson, Jan 15, 2012. Source: New York Daily News.
